findings.F2: The tested idea's profile is too rare to judge it, and the strongest version of its effect sits outside that profile.

findings.F4: The fall after up days in the high-swing tercile is not one coin or one year, though its t over days is weaker than its per-case t.
findings.F5: On the brief's own short side, in choppy, high-swing bars, wide days closing in the top fifth of their range fell -4.16 % the next day (t over days -2.27, 11 days). Narrow ones rose +0.61 % (6 days). Inside the recorded profile, the widest quarter of high closes fell -3.59 % (t -2.19, 13 cases). Choppy agitated short is empty on the profile map, but these case counts are very small.
findings.F6: I looked at many angles, and some patterns did not stand out enough to count.

ideas.idea: In a choppy, agitated market, a day that closes near its high on a range wide against the coin's 30-day swing is followed by a fall over the next day, larger the wider the day against that swing and the nearer the close sits to the high.
ideas.consequence: A trader in a choppy, agitated market sells or refuses to buy after a wide day closing at its high, where the next day tends to give the move back.
ideas.name: choppy agitated high close fade

ideas.idea: In an agitated market, a day that closes near its high on a range wide against the coin's 30-day swing is followed by a fall over the next day, larger the wider the day and the nearer the close sits to its high.
ideas.consequence: In agitated markets a trader treats a wide day closing at its high as a short-term top to fade, not a breakout to chase.
ideas.name: agitated wide high close fade
